Nights, 8 hrs/day, See Comments for Work Schedule

items.item_text: Job offer is contingent upon satisfactory clearance based on Background Check results.
May be required to work overtime by supervisor with little or no advanced notice.
Will be required to work alternate work hours and shifts.
Must be physically able to perform physical labor for extended periods.

This position has been identified as a Mandated Reporter pursuant to the California Child Abuse and Neglect Reporting Act and requires immediate reporting of physical abuse, sexual abuse, emotional abuse, or neglect of anyone under the age of 18.
Six (6) months of experience performing cleaning in a custodial cleaning operation or large multi-facility environment.
Perform the essential functions with, or without, reasonable accommodation.
Knowledge of appropriate cleaning solutions, disinfectants, and equipment (auto scrubbers, carpet extractors, floor buffers) used on a variety of residential floorings, upholstery, and fixtures.
Ability to efficiently clean and maintain rooms, bathrooms, kitchens, and common areas while respecting resident privacy and property.
Demonstrated understanding of protocols for fire alarms, water leaks, bio hazard spills, and other emergencies that can arise in housing facilities.

Demonstrated ability to adapt quickly to shifting priorities, including assignment to special projects or new area assignments on short notice; willingness to work overtime or alternate hours as needs dictate; rapid response to routine and emergency service requests.
Ability to work both independently and as a collaborative partner with students, faculty, staff, and guests providing courteous, student-focused service.
Basic computer skills to check email, approve time, and to complete electronic records as required.
Ability to responsibly manage custodial keys, radios, and any resident related documentation, ensuring security and privacy.
